goal: Order `bakeoff ls` output newest-first by `finished_at`, with a stable, deterministic fallback for legacy or malformed runs whose `finished_at` is missing or unparsable. Add focused unit tests for the ordering function.
background: Today the `bakeoff ls` command in internal/commands/lscmd does not order runs by finished_at descending in a way that is robust to legacy or malformed ledger entries.

Acceptance criteria: (1) runs with well-formed finished_at appear newest-first; (2) runs with missing finished_at sort after all well-formed runs; (3) runs with unparsable finished_at sort after all well-formed runs (same bucket as missing); (4) ties on finished_at are broken deterministically by run id (lexicographic ascending); (5) ordering is implemented as a pure, testable function inside internal/commands/lscmd/**; (6) unit tests cover happy path, missing finished_at, unparsable finished_at, and run-id tiebreak.
All edits must stay inside internal/commands/lscmd/**. Bakeoff will capture candidate patches from isolated worktrees and will not apply them to this checkout.

build.comparison_goal: Prefer the patch that satisfies the acceptance criteria with the smallest maintainable change.
